transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we're meeting to go through the student-services approval checklist for the proposed peer-mediation program before I make my final decision on the operating plan. I'd like to hear from each of you on your assigned checklist items — the advisor on the roster and training status, the counselor on referral-screening requirements, and the school psychologist on safety and supervision requirements. Please go ahead and share your reports one at a time, and I'll record everything along with any required plan changes before making my final approval decision.

transcript.text: As the school psychologist, I need to report on the safety and supervision requirements. My safety review, which I finalized yesterday but have not yet attached to the launch proposal, finds that student mediators may handle only minor peer conflicts — they may not handle threats or moderate conflicts. Additionally, the approved operating protocol must assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session. The current draft proposes only one adult supervisor and allows referrals for moderate conflicts, so both of these must be changed before the plan can be approved.
